newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ridley warns of 10 pct profit fall.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ridley warns of 10 pct profit fall.

text.p: Stockfeed group Ridley Corp Ltd said on Thursday it expected its 1996/97 first half profit to be about 10 percent lower than the previous corresponding period.
However, the company said it expected to maintain the dividend for the full year at 7.5 cents per share.

Ridley told the Australian Stock Exchange that while the percentage fall in the first half applied to net profit after tax, it predicted a fall in operating profit as well due to lower margins for Australian stockfeeds and a 40 percent fall in Australian sales of salt and mineral blocks due to the weak beef industry.

If current trading conditions persisted in the second half of the year, net profit for the full year to June 1997 was forecast to fall to A$21 million from A$22.4 million, Ridley said, although it viewed the current year's weakness as temporary.
The company said its United States division, Feed-Rite, continued to perform strongly with results expected to be well above the prior first half and full year figures.
By 3.40 p.m. (0440 GMT), Ridley shares were 10 cents lower at A$1.55 on turnover of 100,562 shares.
